S.TRANSL: Buay came out from his house.
(he) came out and then turned left.

source note: qayta-an-na babuy‘nay此句的語境類似於以下三句所呈現，分別為(The context is similar to the following:) | source note: (1)ma-tita-na babuy‘nay | source note: (2)ma-qayta-na babuy‘nay | source note: (3)tita-an-na babuy‘nay. | source note: tita-ika!‘去看他!’(Go see him!)， 也可以說成(can also be uttered as) qayta-ika， 但這一句比較少用(but this is rarely used)。

S.TRANSL: then he saw…he saw that pig…

S.TRANSL: 他又經過了(山豬)後,再走下去.
(He) passed (the boar) again and then went down (the mountain).

FORM.notes: source note: 與sinunung-an有關的例句有related clauses include: | source note: (1) sinunung-an-ku qena<si>anem na baqi-an. | source note: 我跟著老人家的想法。 | source note: I went along with the old man’s idea. | source note: (2) kulikuz-an-ku qena<si>anem na baqi-an. | source note: 常用例句有(The more often used clauses include:) | source note: (1) tud-ika! ‘你教他’teach him | source note: (2) t<m>ulu=iku tu sunis zau s<m>udad. | source note: 我教這小孩寫字。 | source note: I teach that child writing.
source note: s<m>uRiR ‘泉水’spring water以及suRiR-an-na zanum ‘泉水（流的水）道’the course through which the spring water flows.

S.TRANSL: and arrived at the big place…road.

FORM.notes: source note: 此句中的za-na應為lazan‘道路’。

S.FORM: nani takawilian zana lepaw ni utay.
nani takawilian zana lepaw ni utay.
S.TRANSL: Utay's home was on the left (of the road).

FORM.notes: source note: 此句是FS (false start).

S.TRANSL: (He) stopped over at Utay's house for one hour.

He saw on the right there was one road that was small;

S.TRANSL: and then went to the front.

FORM.notes: source note: 此句為FS(False start).
source note: 描述土地, 如田, 所用的詞彙應為tabay而非Raya. | source note: The word to refer to land must be ‘tabay’, not ‘Raya’.

S.TRANSL: 那裡有一塊又大又寬的水田.
There was a paddy field that was big and wide over there.
(He) went along the middle of the paddy field.

FORM.notes: source note: 此句猜測應為: maseq ta lazan. ‘到達那一條路’. | source note: This clause should be ‘maseq ta lazan ‘to reach that road’. | source note: 與maseq相關的例句有(related clauses include:) | source note: (1) sa-qaseq-an-ku tasiq-an ‘nay. | source note: 那學校是我要去的 That school is where I am going | source note: (2) ni-qaseq-an-ku ti tasiq-an ‘nay. | source note: 那學校是我去過的 That school is where I’ve been to, 亦等於 | source note: (also equivalent to:) q<n>aseq-an-ku ti tasiq-an 'nay | source note: (3) qaseq=pa=iku tamawaR. | source note: 我明天要去 I will go tomorrow.

S.TRANSL: and crossed the road that was big.

S.FORM: mlazyu lazan 'nay yau muaza paRin tayan nani.

S.FORM: mlazyu lazan 'nay yau muaza paRin tayan nani.

S.TRANSL: 過了大馬路,那裡有很多樹.
(He) crossed that road and there were a lot of trees there.
